control: TLS 1.3 mutual authentication and exact peer certificate pin; uint32 BE canonical JSON <=65536 bytes; methods: hello, register_ingress, admit, resolve_contributors, bind_context, open_relay, renew, close, checkpoint

readiness.lifetime: private 0600 exclusive-create, fsync before serving, refuse existing record; endpoint launcher supplies this exact boot ID to its pinned consumer

admit.context_reuse_semantics: when a completed bound context for (owner, proposed_context_id, key, scope_incarnation, context_epoch) exists on this host and optional prior_generation/context_generation (if supplied) matches that bound generation, admit reuses that generation ID for same-generation complete-contributor context reuse; if scope_incarnation or context_epoch rotated, or the prior turn did not complete, admit mints a fresh generation ID

resolve_contributors.semantics: resolves unseen prior-turn/history contributor delivery references on an admitted capsule or verified key via NativeReader.Resolve with purpose='contributor' in batches <=32 without inserting into seenDeliveries ingress replay tombstones, matching endpoint a3164ded106e06de88f98a6820da4f0d80876dc9

bind_context.core_hash: bytes/sha256 cover canonical JSON of exactly context_id, context_generation, originals; originals are complete native Headers, including the invoking original and all resolved contributor Headers
bind_context.chunk_semantics: each bind_context frame uses manifest containing the chunk descriptor; bytes/hash fixed on first chunk, offset exactly accepted length, standard base64 <=32768 decoded bytes recommended; no truncation/replacement/path/URL; canonical full core verified before binding
bind_context.contributor_resolution: if optional contributor_references/delivery_references are supplied on bind_context before final chunk assembly completes, the host resolves any not-yet-resolved contributor references on the capsule via purpose='contributor' before verifying ObservedHeader and Stage1 contributor intersection

tls_metadata.semantics: populated when include_tls_trust=true and host relay TLS trust material is configured; never disables TLS 1.3 verification

open_relay.http: production URL is HTTPS over PublicationTLSListener (TLS 1.3); handle is a 64-hex one-turn bearer; when relay TLS pins are present, reply includes ca_sha256 (SHA-256 of relay CA PEM bytes) and peer_sha256 (SHA-256 of relay leaf certificate DER), matching checkedTurnRelay in endpoint a3164ded106e06de88f98a6820da4f0d80876dc9
open_relay.stdio: actual pinned CLI executes --turn-relay <handle>; handle is unpadded base64url of a closed JSON ticket <=512 characters containing {ca_sha256, endpoint, peer_sha256, token} when relay TLS pins are present (or {endpoint, token} when unpinned), matching checkedTurnRelay in endpoint a3164ded106e06de88f98a6820da4f0d80876dc9; ServeTurnRelay enforces TLS 1.3 with InsecureSkipVerify=false, custom RootCAs from ca_file/SSL_CERT_FILE/NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS verified against ca_sha256, and VerifyConnection leaf peer_sha256/cert_sha256 pinning
open_relay.relay_executable: private config may name the pinned CLI; empty selects this executable; absolute regular non-writable executable required
open_relay.bearer_domain: 64 lowercase hex characters; ordinary bf_/app_/uk_ credentials are rejected by the relay ticket parser

response_budgets.semantics: optional operator-configured managed-mode JSON response budgets; missing or invalid subfields fail closed with PERMISSION_HOST_CONFIG_INVALID; when omitted, unproven --page-all operations remain fail-closed with policy_unavailable

host_config_optional_fields.defaults: ServePermissionHost defaults relay_ca to peer_ca, relay_ca_sha256 to SHA-256(relay_ca PEM bytes), and relay_peer_sha256/relay_cert_sha256 to SHA-256(server leaf cert DER) when not explicitly overridden

response_budget_runtime_parity.page_budget_prefix_notice: when pagination stops cleanly at max_pages while has_more is true, runPaginated returns the valid JSON array prefix with envelope _notice={code:'PAGE_BUDGET_PREFIX', pages_fetched, page_budget, items_returned, has_more:true, next_cursor}
response_budget_runtime_parity.overflow_error: when max_acquisition_bytes, max_page_items, max_cumulative_bytes, or max_serialized_rpc_bytes is exceeded, returns deterministic RESPONSE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED error with detail={budget_kind, limit, observed}; never truncates JSON bytes and never retries/replays mutating requests; fresh F->B runs at dispatch, every page boundary, and publication

native_reader_bounds.saturation_behavior: fail closed with permission: bundle unavailable (PERMISSION_BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE); never evicts read_id/read_nonce uniqueness fences or HeaderV1 immutability observations via TTL or sliding window

verification: exact pinned endpoint control sources (e4601041 and a3164ded) and v44/v45 convergence harnesses exercised over mTLS 1.3, private-CA TLS 1.3 PublicationTLSListener relay, actual CLI --turn-relay process, checkedTurnRelay ca_sha256/peer_sha256 parity, and configurable response budgets across HTTP and stdio execute/call_op
rpc_identity: JSON-RPC IDs only correlate replies; equal parameters and reused IDs may be legitimate new logical calls. Each BeginCall mints a private call ID and each prepared physical attempt is one-use. Native delivery replay is separately fenced; no argument-based idempotency is invented.
